item.title: Cassidy charges from 13th to claim Mexico City victory as Citroën score first Formula E win - VelocityNews
item.description: Nick Cassidy stormed from 13th on the grid to win the Mexico City E-Prix, delivering Citroën their first-ever Formula E victory in only their second race.
